# tenzir_organization_member (Resource)

Makes an existing user a member of an organization, without an invitation, and keeps the member's roles to exactly `role_ids`. Removing the resource removes the membership.

Needs `Organization.addMember`, which only platform administrators hold, `Organization.listMembers`, `OrganizationRole.assignToMember` and `OrganizationRole.revokeFromMember` on the roles, and `OrganizationMember.remove`. Find a user's ID with the `tenzir_user` data source.

The platform refuses to add a user who already is a member; import such a member instead. Everyone who signs up joins the demo organization, if the platform has one. Do not also manage the member's roles with `tenzir_role_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tenzir_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "tenzir_organization_member" "alice" {
  organization_id = tenzir_organization.demo.id
  user_id         = data.tenzir_user.alice.id
  role_ids        = [tenzir_role.visitor.id, "org.member"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID or slug of the organization.
- `user_id` (String) The ID of the user.

### Optional

- `role_ids` (Set of String) Built-in role IDs such as `org.member`, or custom roles' IDs. Defaults to none.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The member ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization>/<user ID>, with the organization by ID or slug.
terraform import tenzir_organization_member.alice demo/01a1a205-9e50-7d13-bac1-3f47f9cc4297
```
